scope: Additive source-exact BAL-ATL final-game reconciliation. This promotes the saved official gamebook timelines through the approved historical QB, replacement-role and elapsed-time models. It writes no current-week overlay, fair or betting output.

sources.finding: Official final gamebook reports Baltimore 30, Atlanta 23 in overtime; complete lineups, substitutions, inactive/DNP inventories, playtime, and every printed injury/return sequence. Official final Week 5 report identifies Lamar Jackson, Cam Jurgens and Trey Hendrickson out for Baltimore; Yasir Abdullah out and the final Atlanta questionable designations.
Baltimore confirms Huntley for Jackson, Green for Hendrickson, Ioane at center, Jones at right guard, Jurgens not yet debuted, and Edoga elevated for tackle depth.
Baltimore elevated Chuma Edoga and identified Carson Vinson as the other available reserve tackle for the Falcons game.
Official depth chart lists Chandler Rivers directly behind Kyle Hamilton, John Jenkins behind Travis Jones at nose tackle, and Mike Green behind Trey Hendrickson at rush linebacker.

Official roster review identifies the continuing reserve-list players; the final gamebook confirms none was activated for this game. No established Week 5 game-day duty is assigned to the listed reserve-only exclusions.
Atlanta placed Yasir Abdullah on injured reserve and elevated Bralen Trice and Drake Jackson; the gamebook lists both edge players active.
Official Week 5 depth chart lists Mike Ford Jr. directly behind Mike Hughes and preserves the distinct outside-corner and nickel chains.
Atlanta reports Mike Ford entered immediately after Mike Hughes was injured on the prior snap; the gamebook records Hughes's return after the next touchdown sequence.
Atlanta confirms Penix's late rib injury and Tagovailoa's injury-driven relief; the official gamebook supplies the two disjoint relief intervals.
Atlanta placed A.J. Terrell Jr. on injured reserve and identified C.J. Henderson as the outside-corner replacement; the Week 5 gamebook confirms Henderson started.
